description: Get a tappable link that opens a project directly in the editor (the editor loads exactly this project from the URL). Returns { name, editorUrl }. Use this whenever the user wants to view their work — after you make a change, or when they say "show me" / "open it" — then give them the editorUrl and invite them to tap it. Refer to the project by its name in your reply; the link is the tap target.
